WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.

5. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

6. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

7. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.

8. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

9. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
